Executive Summary & Migration Recommendations

Based on traffic volume and bounce rate analysis, we recommend a focused migration strategy:

✅ KEEP & OPTIMIZE

  • /di/ & /tdi/: The "Power Categories". These drive the majority of high-quality traffic.
  • /fw/ & /fr/: Specific Route/Region pages are critical for capturing long-tail intent.

❌ EXCLUDE (Do Not Generate)

  • /d/ & /a/: Too broad (Destination/Activity only). Users bouncing significantly.
  • /rbs/, /f/, /o/: Legacy namespaces with poor metrics or redundant content.
